text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-2024-3382 triggered for inference-prod-us-west-2 — latency > 2s sustained for 6m, error-rate rising. Primary on-call: Oncall-Emma. Escalation window: 9m.
Oncall-Emma: ack
Oncall-Emma: I'm on it, heads-up I'm stepping into a meeting in ~5m; if I don't respond please escalate. :wave:
pagerduty-bot: Reminder: auto-escalation to secondary in 6m unless acknowledged by primary.
Alex: seeing queue depth spike on gpu-pool-03, qlen 240 -> 1200 over 5m. nodes reporting OOMs and repeated model reboots.
Priya: checking autoscaler logs, looks like a GC stall + retry loop from the model container causing sustained backlog.
Jamal: I didn't get the PD page earlier (phone was on DND). can someone tag me here? joining from laptop now.
Leah (Support): multiple customers reporting 502s and >3s responses for embeddings endpoint. Opening priority tickets and pinging top affected accounts.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: alert PD-2024-3382 escalated to secondary Jamal (primary silent window expired) at 1755556810.
Jamal: ack
Jamal: grabbing logs and core dumps: `kubectl logs -n inference deployment/model-serving --tail=200` — repeated retry/backoff spikes, stack shows mem growth in batch processing path.
Alex: rolling back recent qbatch config to prevent large batch growth. executing: ```kubectl apply -f /ops/configs/qbatch-revert.yaml``` will monitor for stabilization.
Oncall-Emma: I acknowledged earlier but had to step away — back now and coordinating with Jamal. do we need a bridge?
Maya (Manager): I'm on-call escalation — seeing this escalated to me. if SLA breaches are likely, open a bridge and notify execs.
Jamal: mitigation in progress: draining gpu-pool-03 and routing traffic to gpu-pool-07 with a runtime route override. command: ```redwoodctl route set inference-prod-us-west-2 --pool gpu-pool-07 --route-id route-481``` latencies showing downward trend.
Priya: autoscaler was stuck on a GC-related loop; pushed hotfix to restart the scaler on fail and deployed at 1755556855. autoscaler restarted and began scale-up, queue draining.
Leah (Support): status page updated: "Partial degradation: increased latency and 502s for embeddings in US-WEST-2. Mitigation in progress." Customers notified via support channels.
maya (Manager): can we confirm impact window and affected request volume?
Alex: impact window start ~1755556500. about 0.7% of total RPS affected but concentrated on several high-QPS tenants. applied temporary tenant rate-limiter: ```kong plugin apply rate-limiter --tenant=heavy-qps``` to limit blast radius.
pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation notification sent to Maya (Manager) at 1755556845 per escalation policy.
Oncall-Emma: creating incident doc under /incidents/PD-2024-3382-draft, capturing initial timeline and mitigation steps.
Jamal: restarted failed replicas and verified model process memory stabilized. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-serving -n inference --selector=pool=gpu-pool-03`
Priya: hotfix verified; autoscaler behaving normally, queue drained to baseline.
Alex: removed route override and shifted traffic back to gpu-pool-03 after health checks. latencies back to ~120ms.
Leah (Support): status page updated: mitigation complete, monitoring. follow-up emails to affected customers scheduled.
Maya (Manager): summary — root cause likely interplay of a qbatch config change that allowed runaway batch growth and an autoscaler GC edge-case. owners: Alex (config), Priya (autoscaler). postmortem and timeline within 48h in #postmortems.
Oncall-Emma: will keep PD alert open until 10m of stable metrics, then close.
incident-bot: Alert PD-2024-3382 resolved at 1755556860. auto-close triggered.
Maya (Manager): thanks team. I'll schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow and assign action items. :thumbsup:
